interface Arg { action(value: number): void; }
class Arg { action(value: string) { console.log(value.toUpperCase()); } }
new Arg().action(1);

class Returned { action(value: number) { return value; } }
interface Returned { action(value: number): string; }

const prop = Symbol("action");
interface Keyed { [prop](value: number): void; }
class Keyed { [prop](value: string) { console.log(value.toUpperCase()); } }

class Ordinary {
  action(value: number): void;
  action(value: string) { console.log(value.toUpperCase()); }
}
